name: Push-ups
instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart; lower chest to floor keeping body straight; push back up.

name: Incline push-ups
instructions: Hands on a raised surface; lower chest to the edge and press up.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench; press dumbbells up from chest until arms are straight; lower slowly.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Lower the bar to mid-chest under control; drive it up without bouncing.

name: Triceps dips (chair)
instructions: Hands on a chair edge; bend elbows to 90 degrees; press back up.

name: Dumbbell triceps extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands; lower behind head; extend.

name: Dumbbell bicep curls
instructions: Keep elbows fixed at your sides; curl the weights up and lower slowly.

name: Hammer curls
instructions: Palms facing each other; curl up without swinging the body.

name: Superman hold
instructions: Lie face down; lift arms and legs together; hold 2 seconds; lower.

name: Bent-over dumbbell row
instructions: Hinge forward with flat back; pull dumbbells to your hips; squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to upper chest keeping chest up; return slowly.

name: Pull-ups
instructions: Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders; pull chin above the bar; lower fully.

name: Bodyweight squats
instructions: Feet shoulder-width; sit hips back and down; keep chest up; stand.

name: Lunges
instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor; push back to start.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent; lift hips and squeeze glutes; lower.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at chest; squat deep keeping heels down.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hinge at hips with soft knees; lower weights along legs; stand tall.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Bar on upper back; squat to parallel; drive through heels.

name: Pike push-ups
instructions: Hips high in an inverted V; lower head toward the floor; press up.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height; lower under control.

name: Lateral raises
instructions: Raise dumbbells to shoulder height with slight elbow bend; lower slowly.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on floor; keep body straight from head to heels; breathe steadily.

name: Bicycle crunches
instructions: Alternate elbow to opposite knee while the legs pedal.

name: Russian twists
instructions: Lean back slightly; rotate torso side to side touching the floor.

name: Leg raises
instructions: Lie flat; lift straight legs to 90 degrees; lower slowly without arching back.

name: Jumping jacks
instructions: Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead; return and repeat.

name: High knees
instructions: Run in place driving knees to hip height.

name: Burpees
instructions: Squat; jump feet back; push-up; jump up with arms overhead.

name: Mountain climbers
instructions: From plank; drive knees to chest alternately at speed.

name: Treadmill brisk walk/run
instructions: Maintain a steady pace; raise incline gradually if comfortable.

name: Skipping rope
instructions: Light jumps on the balls of your feet; keep wrists relaxed.

name: Dumbbell thrusters
instructions: Squat holding dumbbells at shoulders; stand and press overhead in one move.

name: Cat-cow stretch
instructions: On hands and knees; alternate arching and rounding your back slowly.

name: Downward dog
instructions: Hips up and back; heels toward the floor; lengthen the spine.

name: Hamstring stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended; hinge forward from the hips; hold.
